devices.title: We now have a more definite timeframe for Samsung Galaxy Buds On's Europe launch
devices.description: The Samsung Galaxy Buds On wireless earphones, unveiled last month, are currently only available in South Korea and the US. Samsung said the Buds On would come to Europe in early 2027 without getting specific. Well, we now have a more definite timeframe for the Galaxy Buds On's European debut. Citing their sources, SamMobile claims the Samsung Galaxy Buds On will launch in Europe in the third week of 2027. We still don't have the launch date, but at least we now have a more definite launch timef
